label: Add the custom response of the ban commands
summary: Adds column "response_ban" to "GuildModeration" when it does not have it

execute.description: add the column, empty for the guilds that are there
execute.sql: ALTER TABLE "public"."GuildModeration" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "response_ban" text

postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'GuildModeration' AND column_name = 'response_ban') AS "result"
